title: 3Sum
prompt: Given an integer array `nums`, return all unique triplets `[nums[i], nums[j], nums[k]]` such that `i != j != k` and the three values sum to 0. The result must not contain duplicate triplets.
hints: Sort the array first — this makes it possible to use two pointers and to skip duplicates cleanly.
Fix one number, then use a two-pointer scan (left/right) over the remaining sorted subarray looking for pairs that sum to its negation.
After sorting, skip over repeated values for both the fixed index and the two pointers to avoid duplicate triplets.
